capabilities: Preview bulk frontmatter and property changes before applying them
Apply frontmatter and tag operations to selected notes
Connect an account and buy credits for AI operations
Send selected input to an AI service
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Freemium: the eight local frontmatter and tag operations work offline, while AI and folder operations require credits bought through the Constance/Paddle billing flow. Error reports including possible file paths or content are sent to Datadog.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to safely make bulk frontmatter and property changes across many notes with exact rollback.

relations.evidence: Authentication, current offers, free allowance, purchased balance and payment confirmation use the Constance v2 service

summary: Bulk frontmatter editor that previews, applies and rolls back frontmatter and tag operations across selected notes, with optional paid AI actions.
